components.title: NETApps Electric Simulation application, installer and privileged helper

changelog.text: Motion on the schematic: motors turn at a rate proportional to their torque, with torque and speed shown; servo horns point at their simulated angle; transient playback on the schematic. Induction motors have a Poles property. New example: hobby servo. Fixed: the electrical rule check reported nets of TVS diodes, bridge rectifiers, IGBTs, optocouplers, the TL431, NTC thermistors and fuses, and the servo and DC-motor outputs, as floating.

Temperature analysis: circuit temperature (as SPICE .temp) for diodes, LEDs, transistors, MOSFETs and resistors (temperature coefficient), and the temperature as a stepped property of the parameter sweep. Pulse measurements in the waveform viewer: rise and fall time, period, duty cycle, overshoot. FFT view: frequencies between bins, no aliasing, full resolution of stepped runs. New parts: TVS diodes (uni- and bidirectional), IGBTs, optocoupler, TL431 shunt reference, bridge rectifiers, NTC thermistor, fuse; more models (BAT54, SS34, BD139/BD140, AO3400, AO3401, IRF540N, LM324, MCP6002, NE5532, MCP1700, L78L05). Help: technical reference with the theory and the code of every analysis.

SPICE .model import for diodes and transistors; parameter sweep of up to three properties; tolerance analysis (Monte Carlo); stress check (smoke analysis) against maximum ratings; logic gates and D flip-flop; SPICE-style truncation-error step control; corrected first point of a 555 started at power-on.

Renamed NETApps Electric Simulation, with its own logo. New parts: transformer, three-phase transformer (Dyn, Yyn, Yd, Dd), three-phase source, relay, DC motor, single- and three-phase AC motors, hobby servo. Parameter sweep (.step), FFT view with THD, bill of materials, text notes, single-frequency AC analysis, property limits.

Potentiometer sliders follow the drag and keep the value; Ctrl+R and Shift+R rotate, Y flips; pan and zoom-area tools, a view toolbar on the canvas, Shift+wheel pans; every part checked in a test circuit; op-amp output limits and the LM358 low-side swing corrected; parts left on their own no longer stop the simulation; clearer messages for an unconnected ground and a reference already in use.

Wire and part collisions are asked about (connect, route around, cancel) instead of connected silently; window layout options: results below or beside the schematic, splitter, maximise, panels on and off, kept between sessions.

Increment 2 (D17): start screen and tutorial, schematic editor, electrical rule check, circuit simulator (operating point, transient, AC, DC sweep; cross-checked against ngspice), probes and waveform viewer, 555 timer and regulators, projects with version history, SVG/PNG/SPICE/CSV export.
Increment 1: application shell, CM backbone, integrity check, installer, privileged-helper skeleton.
